paragraphs.en: CLI tool for configuring and monitoring Claude Code

paragraphs.en: Swiftproxy proudly supports this project. Connect your AI-powered workflows to reliable residential proxies for web data collection, browser automation, and AI-driven research. 90M+ residential IPs across 220+ locations, rotating and static residential proxies, with HTTP(S) and SOCKS5 support.

paragraphs.en: Ready-to-use configurations for Anthropic's Claude Code. A comprehensive collection of AI agents, custom commands, settings, hooks, external integrations (MCPs), and project templates to enhance your development workflow.
paragraphs.zh: Anthropic 的 Claude Code 开箱即用配置。 一套全面的 AI 智能体、自定义命令、设置、钩子、外部集成（MCP）和项目模板，用于增强你的开发工作流。

sents.en: Ready-to-use configurations for Anthropic's Claude Code.
sents.zh: Anthropic 的 Claude Code 开箱即用配置。

sents.en: A comprehensive collection of AI agents, custom commands, settings, hooks, external integrations (MCPs), and project templates to enhance your development workflow.
sents.zh: 一套全面的 AI 智能体、自定义命令、设置、钩子、外部集成（MCP）和项目模板，用于增强你的开发工作流。

paragraphs.en: Browse All Templates - Interactive web interface to explore and install 100+ agents, commands, settings, hooks, and MCPs.
paragraphs.zh: 浏览所有模板 - 交互式网页界面，用于浏览和安装 100+ 个智能体、命令、设置、钩子（hooks）和 MCP。

paragraphs.en: # Install a complete development stack npx claude-code-templates@latest --agent development-team/frontend-developer --command testing/generate-tests --mcp development/github-integration --yes # Browse and install interactively npx claude-code-templates@latest # Install specific components npx claude-code-templates@latest --agent development-tools/code-reviewer --yes npx claude-code-templates@latest --command performance/optimize-bundle --yes npx claude-code-templates@latest --setting performance/mcp-timeouts --yes npx claude-code-templates@latest --hook git/pre-commit-validation --yes npx claude-code-templates@latest --mcp database/postgresql-integration --yes What You Get Component Description Examples 🤖 Agents AI specialists for specific domains Security auditor, React performance optimizer, database architect ⚡ Commands Custom slash commands /generate-tests , /optimize-bundle , /check-security 🔌 MCPs External service integrations GitHub, PostgreSQL, Stripe, AWS, OpenAI ⚙️ Settings Claude Code configurations Timeouts, memory settings, output styles 🪝 Hooks Automation triggers Pre-commit validation, post-completion actions 🎨 Skills Reusable capabilities with progressive disclosure PDF processing, Excel automation, custom workflows 🛠️ Additional Tools Beyond the template catalog, Claude Code Templates includes powerful development tools:
paragraphs.zh:
# 安装完整的开发环境栈
npx claude-code-templates@latest --agent development-team/frontend-developer --command testing/generate-tests --mcp development/github-integration --yes

# 交互式浏览并安装
npx claude-code-templates@latest

# 安装特定组件
npx claude-code-templates@latest --agent development-tools/code-reviewer --yes
npx claude-code-templates@latest --command performance/optimize-bundle --yes
npx claude-code-templates@latest --setting performance/mcp-timeouts --yes
npx claude-code-templates@latest --hook git/pre-commit-validation --yes
npx claude-code-templates@latest --mcp database/postgresql-integration --yes

## 你将获得

| 组件 | 描述 | 示例 |
|---|---|---|
| 🤖 智能体 | 针对特定领域的 AI 专家 | 安全审计员、React 性能优化器、数据库架构师 |
| ⚡ 命令 | 自定义斜杠命令 | `/generate-tests`、`/optimize-bundle`、`/check-security` |
| 🔌 MCP | 外部服务集成 | GitHub、PostgreSQL、Stripe、AWS、OpenAI |
| ⚙️ 设置 | Claude Code 配置 | 超时、内存设置、输出样式 |
| 🪝 钩子 | 自动化触发器 | 提交前验证、完成后操作 |
| 🎨 技能 | 具有渐进式披露的可复用能力 | PDF 处理、Excel 自动化、自定义工作流 |

## 🛠️ 其他工具

除了模板目录之外，Claude Code Templates 还包含强大的开发工具：

paragraphs.en: Monitor your AI-powered development sessions in real-time with live state detection and performance metrics.
paragraphs.zh: 通过实时状态检测和性能指标，实时监控您的 AI 驱动开发会话。

paragraphs.en: npx claude-code-templates@latest --analytics 💬 Conversation Monitor Mobile-optimized interface to view Claude responses in real-time with secure remote access.
paragraphs.zh: npx claude-code-templates@latest --analytics 💬 对话监控器 移动端优化的界面，可通过安全的远程访问实时查看 Claude 的响应。

paragraphs.en: # Local access npx claude-code-templates@latest --chats # Secure remote access via Cloudflare Tunnel npx claude-code-templates@latest --chats --tunnel 🔍 Health Check Comprehensive diagnostics to ensure your Claude Code installation is optimized.
paragraphs.zh: # 本地访问 npx claude-code-templates@latest --chats # 通过 Cloudflare Tunnel 安全地进行远程访问 npx claude-code-templates@latest --chats --tunnel 🔍 健康检查 综合诊断，确保你的 Claude Code 安装处于最佳状态。

paragraphs.en: npx claude-code-templates@latest --health-check 🔌 Plugin Dashboard View marketplaces, installed plugins, and manage permissions from a unified interface.
paragraphs.zh: npx claude-code-templates@latest --health-check 🔌 插件仪表板 通过统一的界面查看市场、已安装的插件，并管理权限。

paragraphs.en: npx claude-code-templates@latest --plugins 📖 Documentation 📚 docs.aitmpl.com - Complete guides, examples, and API reference for all components and tools.
paragraphs.zh: npx claude-code-templates@latest --plugins 📖 文档 📚 docs.aitmpl.com - 所有组件与工具的完整指南、示例和 API 参考。
